description: A React component for uploading documents, managing upload state, and orchestrating persona generation workflows within a Next.js frontend. It includes UI elements for drag-and-drop uploads, file management, and interaction with backend API endpoints for document handling and orchestration.

classes.name: UploadCard
classes.description: A React component representing a file upload card for different categories, supporting drag-and-drop and file browsing.

classes.name: LinkedInConnect
classes.description: A React component providing UI for connecting a LinkedIn profile.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Utility function to format a number of bytes into a human-readable string.

methods.name: getFileExtLabel
methods.description: Returns a label based on the file extension or 'FILE' if none.

methods.name: categoryLabel
methods.description: Maps an upload category to a display label.

methods.name: categoryTitle
methods.description: Provides a title string for a given upload category.

methods.name: categoryAccent
methods.description: Returns a color code associated with each upload category.

methods.name: acceptString
methods.description: Returns the accepted file types string for file inputs.

methods.name: onFilesSelected
methods.description: Handler for when files are selected or dropped, updating upload list state.

methods.name: removePreview
methods.description: Removes an uploaded file from the list by ID.

methods.name: onGenerateDraft
methods.description: Main workflow function to upload documents, select them, trigger orchestration, store results, and navigate to the draft view.
